description: The `advisers status --json` contract: always the first command a consumer can call (no TOS acceptance, no key, no model) and the carrier of the additive contracts discovery field.
deterministicNote: Values depend on the local home (paths/counts/version); the SHAPE is stable. It is excluded from the byte-determinism expectations of eval, not from the schema check.

discovery.rule: Additive optional object. When present, every key must equal versions-v1.json discovery.expected (mcpProtocol may be any version listed in mcp/versions-v1.json supportedProtocolVersions). Consumers that do not see it must assume the v1 defaults.
discovery.note: Adding this field requires a bin/ change, which is outside the contracts-only implementation (Wave 2 integration). The checker prints INFO while it is absent and fails if it is present but inconsistent.

invariants: status must succeed on a fresh HOME with no TOS acceptance and no credentials
status must not require a model/key, and must not print diagnostics to stdout in --json mode
existing keys keep their meaning; new keys are additive (backward compatible)
